purpose: Validate cross-frame phase without delay/Doppler path search before any full-run adoption
selection_rule: Use the final tenth phase update; never select a round or threshold using truth. Primary candidate fixed before running; frame version is a diagnostic comparison only.
noise: Observation-only spatial MDL, identical frozen implementation
variance: Calibrated feedback variance is a disclosed isotropic proxy, not a verified posterior covariance
oracle: Known phase used only as a separately labeled diagnostic; noise remains estimated
frozen_model: Current FINAL epoch 1 depth 10; no retraining, threshold change, or physical phase initialization
launch: Launch a separate 2000-scene main-run plan only after the primary candidate passes every gate; retain old plan and results
